headline: Accepted December 16 minutes and reviewed library budget, HVAC project, and staffing updates.
summary: Trustees approved December meeting minutes and heard reports on the fiscal year 2026 budget, the ongoing HVAC project, elevator and bookmobile repairs, new study room reservations, and personnel changes including a hiring freeze affecting the library's billing position. The board also noted that three trustee appointments were approved by City Council on January 20.
decisions: Accepted the minutes of the December 16, 2026 meeting as amended, motion passed 6-0 with Altman, Behrle, Handly, Michaels, O'Reilly, and Panunzio voting in favor.
